messages:
marta: Quick sync — partners asked for final wave priority and press embargo windows for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi. We need to lock by EOD Wed so marketing can prep. Key questions: which models in Wave A, embargo phasing, and SI onramp policy.

sam: Proposal: keep Wave A small (H100 + Gaudi preview) as a low-risk headline, Wave B brings MI300 and H200 GA. SI preview program as opt-in to Wave A for 2–3 SIs only.

raj: Agree on staged approach. One ask: MI300 supply still looks volatile — do we have fallback mapping to H200 for customers who asked for MI300? If yes, we need that documented for marketplace SKUs.

elena: Timeline idea (tentative):
```
- Wave A (announce & limited marketplace listing): week of 2025-04-21
- SI preview/canary enrollments: 2025-04-21 -> 2025-05-05
- Wave B (broader GA + MI300 listing): week of 2025-05-05
```
This buys two weeks to validate images and perf.

tim-sv: Vendor note from earlier: firmware microcode for H200 might slip by ~1 week. If that happens we should move H200 to Wave C and promote H100/H200 alignment accordingly. Also vendors want a 72h embargo buffer before press picks up.

michelle-marketing: 72h buffer is fine, but we need final asset list by Tue COB (one page PDF, benchmark blurb, partner quotes). Also we prefer the initial headline to call out performance/cost numbers vs "generic GPU" — need vendor signoff on numbers. :memo:

marta: Action items:
- @sam document Wave A/B/C SKU mapping and fallback matrix (due Tue 12pm PT)
- @raj compile MI300 supply risk note + fallback rules (due Tue 3pm PT)
- @tim-sv confirm firmware slippage windows with vendors and publish embargo buffer (due Tue EOD)
- @michelle-marketing confirm asset checklist and announce cadence (due Tue COB)

nvidia-prod-bot: Vendor update: NVIDIA confirms H100 GA week-of-2025-04-21; H200 microcode ETA 2025-05-02 (subject to change).

sam: I'll start the fallback matrix. Quick question — do we allow customers to pick "model-agnostic pool" for marketplace SKUs that will route to cheapest compatible card if requested? That affects SKU naming.

marta: Yes, allow model-agnostic pools but require explicit opt-in checkbox in marketplace workflow. Add a warning about potential perf variance.

elena: Also flag observability: console dashboards need separate rows for Wave A preview SKUs so early customers don't skew benchmarks.

tim-sv: Noted. I'll add a tag schema: wave:A preview, wave:B ga, fallback: H200->H100 mapping.

michelle-marketing: If we lock Wave A tomorrow, I'll draft the embargoed press brief and share for review. Expect a google doc link by Tue morning. :thumbsup:

marta: Great. If no objections by EOD Wed we ship this plan. Thanks everyone.
